preview.markup.copyCodeBlock.comment: Context-menu command and accessibility label for the native margin button when the code language is unknown. Copies one already-concealed displayed code body via the existing privacy copy service; never copies fences, labels or surrounding prose. All translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.
